seo.title: Triathlon coaching – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Hands-on triathlon coaching: ongoing 1:1 support via WhatsApp, replies in under 3 hours, day-to-day planning when needed.

title: Triathlon coaching
lead: Hands-on instead of off-the-shelf plans: I support you continuously and personally – in direct contact via WhatsApp, with fast replies and planning that adapts to your life day by day.

offer.title: Premium Coaching
offer.text: I'm not there once a week – I'm there whenever it matters. We stay in ongoing contact via WhatsApp: heavy legs, a business trip, a sick child or a great day – I adjust your training right away. When needed, we plan day by day.
features: Ongoing contact via WhatsApp – as often as you need
Immediate adjustments to life, form and health
Analysis of your training and performance data
offer.note: Limited spots – that's the only way to keep support this close.

process.title: Intro call
process.text: A free first conversation about your goals, experience and everyday life.

process.title: Analysis
process.text: I review your training data and define the starting point.

process.title: Start & direct line
process.text: You get your plan and my direct WhatsApp line – from now on we're in constant contact.

process.title: Adjust daily
process.text: We adapt training whenever needed – day by day if required.

faq.question: How fast do you reply?
faq.answer: In under 3 hours. Just message me on WhatsApp whenever you have a question or something needs adjusting.

faq.question: How often can we talk?
faq.answer: As often as you need. The coaching is deliberately hands-on – from a quick question before a session to daily check-ins.

faq.question: What does day-to-day planning mean?
faq.answer: Instead of a rigid weekly plan, we can set your training fresh each day when needed – matched to your form, your sleep and your schedule.

faq.question: Who is the coaching for?
faq.answer: Ambitious athletes who want close, personal support – from a first triathlon to the full distance.
